topic: Original i76.exe VLOC type-0x28 writer for camera vehicle runtime+0x398 and status-bit eligibility
summary: Original retail VLOC parser 004AE000 and status predicate 00458BF0 produce class-0x28 attachment to runtime+0x398 from both verified GTSi/bus VDF source records when world flag 0x10 is set. Original default camera 00406AB0 advances past its null guard only in flagged cases; low-level node allocator and class binder remain explicitly substituted. 104 private verification checks and repeated byte-identical Ghidra traces.

reproducibility.limitations: Requires privately held retail executable, private GZF and ZFS/VDF bytes. The world object is controlled and not constructed via a full flagged VCF load. 0045EBD0 allocator/00461970 class-registration are substituted; full real class registry unresolved. Original camera halted immediately after null guard, no valid camera pose, framebuffer or original x87 parity. Full private original code trace and proprietary payloads are not in public Git.
